cause: The publication model treated the Git-owned prepared lock and the Runtime-owned post-publication lock as adjacent critical sections without carrying an unforgeable cooperative identity across the unlocked handoff.
prevention: Keep the authorized symbolic HEAD regular file open across publication, validate its device/inode/link/content under Git's prepared lock before and after delegated hooks, compare that held identity again under Runtime's reacquired lock, expose published_unverified as terminal non-success, and fail closed when the POSIX no-follow primitive is unavailable.
summary: A value-only check after Git released HEAD.lock could miss a final-state-preserving equal-OID A-to-B-to-A symbolic-ref round trip before Runtime reacquired the lock.
title: Symbolic HEAD publication needs a verifiable lock handoff
